source_instruction: i need a chrome wall lamp that is brushed nickel.
query: Oh man, I spent twenty minutes this morning chasing my neighbor’s escaped tabby cat all around the apartment complex, it bolted right past me when I was taking out the recycling and darted up a oak tree by the mailboxes. I also burned my oatmeal for the third time this week because I got distracted scrolling through old vacation photos from that beach trip two summers ago, the ones where my friend tripped over a sandcastle and face-planted into a cooler of lemonade. I even realized halfway to the subway that I’d put on two different socks, one striped with neon yellow and one plain gray, and had to run back up three flights of stairs to change before I missed my train. I’ve heard that for the wall sconces I’ve been eyeing for the hallway, brushed nickel is the standard finish most people go for, though chrome is a nice alternate option to consider, and all the picks I’ve glanced at so far sit right under an $80 price point.
